questions.explanation: 原句表示：这些旧玩具并不是给小学生用来“娱乐(entertainment)”的，而是用于解释科学概念。选项B符合语境转折的逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(education)：a) 语境句：The government is investing heavily in public education. b) 固定搭配：receive education, higher education
B(entertainment)：a) 语境句：The film is designed for entertainment rather than for study. b) 固定搭配：for entertainment, entertainment industry
C(experiment)：a) 语境句：The scientist conducted an experiment to test his theory. b) 固定搭配：do/conduct an experiment, a scientific experiment
D(training)：a) 语境句：The new employees will receive basic training next week. b) 固定搭配：professional training, job training

questions.explanation: 这里表示科学老师用玩具来“阐明、解释(illustrate)”复杂的科学概念。选项A最符合“用简单方式讲解复杂概念”的语意。
questions.supplement:
A(illustrate)：a) 语境句：The teacher used a diagram to illustrate the complex scientific theory. b) 固定搭配：illustrate the point, be illustrated with
B(create)：a) 语境句：The new policy is designed to create more job opportunities. b) 固定搭配：create an atmosphere, create a miracle
C(adopt)：a) 语境句：We should adopt a more flexible approach to solving the problem. b) 固定搭配：adopt a method, adopt a child
D(revise)：a) 语境句：You need to revise your essay before submitting it. b) 固定搭配：revise a plan, revise for an exam

questions.explanation: 因为他用旧玩具教复杂科学的这种方法非常新颖独特，因此被称为“创新的(innovative)”教学方法。
questions.supplement:
A(objective)：a) 语境句：You must make an objective assessment of the situation. b) 固定搭配：objective reality, an objective view
B(innovative)：a) 语境句：The company is famous for its innovative design in technology. b) 固定搭配：innovative approach, innovative ideas
C(professional)：a) 语境句：You should seek professional advice before making the investment. b) 固定搭配：professional skills, professional knowledge
D(changeable)：a) 语境句：The weather in this region is quite changeable in autumn. b) 固定搭配：changeable weather, a changeable mood

questions.explanation: 根据后文描述“既没有实验室，孩子们也没有热情，连课都不上”，说明在Kar加入之前，这里的科学教育从未被“欣赏/重视(appreciated)”。
questions.supplement:
A(taught)：a) 语境句：He was taught how to behave properly in public. b) 固定搭配：teach a lesson, teach oneself
B(expanded)：a) 语境句：The company expanded its business into the Asian market. b) 固定搭配：expand business, expand horizons
C(appreciated)：a) 语境句：His talent for music was highly appreciated by his teachers. b) 固定搭配：highly appreciate, deeply appreciated
D(forgotten)：a) 语境句：The heroic deeds of those soldiers will never be forgotten. b) 固定搭配：easily forgotten, completely forgotten

questions.explanation: 句意：既没有实验室，孩子们对这门学科也没有“热情(passion)”。passion完美对应后文孩子们回家不再回来的厌学状态。
questions.supplement:
A(talent)：a) 语境句：She showed a remarkable talent for playing the piano. b) 固定搭配：have a talent for, musical talent
B(duty)：a) 语境句：It is your duty to look after your aging parents. b) 固定搭配：do one's duty, a sense of duty
C(support)：a) 语境句：The project wouldn't have succeeded without their financial support. b) 固定搭配：financial support, strong support
D(passion)：a) 语境句：He has a great passion for literature and writes every day. b) 固定搭配：a passion for, follow one's passion

questions.explanation: 科学课被“安排(scheduled)”在午休后开始。be scheduled to do sth为常见固定搭配，意为“被安排做某事”。
questions.supplement:
A(selected)：a) 语境句：She was selected to represent the school in the competition. b) 固定搭配：be selected as, carefully selected
B(scheduled)：a) 语境句：The flight is scheduled to take off at 9 a.m. b) 固定搭配：be scheduled for, be scheduled to do
C(considered)：a) 语境句：It is considered polite to bring a small gift when visiting someone. b) 固定搭配：be considered as, generally considered
D(suspended)：a) 语境句：The football match was suspended because of the heavy rain. b) 固定搭配：be suspended from, suspended sentence

questions.explanation: 正是这种尴尬的现状“驱使/促使(drove)”Kar决定使用玩具来教学。drive sb to do sth意为“迫使/促使某人做某事”。
questions.supplement:
A(permitted)：a) 语境句：Visitors are not permitted to take photos in the museum. b) 固定搭配：be permitted to do, permit doing sth
B(entitled)：a) 语境句：You are entitled to a full refund if the goods are damaged. b) 固定搭配：be entitled to, be entitled to do
C(drove)：a) 语境句：The unbearable noise drove him to leave the room. b) 固定搭配：drive sb crazy, drive sb to do
D(requested)：a) 语境句：All guests are requested to leave their bags at the front desk. b) 固定搭配：be requested to do, formally request

questions.explanation: Kar说孩子们喜欢玩具，如果给他们玩具玩，他们就会“自愿地/主动地(voluntarily)”来上课。
questions.supplement:
A(secretly)：a) 语境句：He secretly slipped out of the room during the meeting. b) 固定搭配：secretly admire, secretly hope
B(barely)：a) 语境句：His voice was barely audible over the loud music. b) 固定搭配：barely survive, barely enough
C(voluntarily)：a) 语境句：Many students voluntarily participated in the community service. b) 固定搭配：participate voluntarily, work voluntarily
D(unexpectedly)：a) 语境句：The weather turned unexpectedly cold during the night. b) 固定搭配：happen unexpectedly, arrive unexpectedly

questions.explanation: Kar利用玩具制作低成本的“教具(teaching aids)”，吸引学生参与实验。aids在此指辅助工具。
questions.supplement:
A(aids)：a) 语境句：Maps and videos are useful teaching aids in geography class. b) 固定搭配：teaching aids, visual aids
B(labs)：a) 语境句：The students spent the whole afternoon working in the computer labs. b) 固定搭配：science lab, language lab
C(references)：a) 语境句：He made several references to his previous work in his speech. b) 固定搭配：reference book, make reference to
D(presents)：a) 语境句：The children were excited to open their birthday presents. b) 固定搭配：birthday present, give a present

questions.explanation: 使用玩具做实验，使得整个科学学习的过程对学生们变得“有吸引力的(appealing)”。
questions.supplement:
A(precious)：a) 语境句：Clean water is a precious resource in many parts of the world. b) 固定搭配：precious time, precious memories
B(abstract)：a) 语境句：The concept of beauty is somewhat abstract and subjective. b) 固定搭配：abstract art, abstract concept
C(available)：a) 语境句：The information is available on the official website. b) 固定搭配：readily available, be available to
D(appealing)：a) 语境句：The idea of living in the countryside is very appealing to me. b) 固定搭配：visually appealing, find sth appealing

questions.explanation: 随着学生好奇心的增长，科学课的“出勤率(attendance)”增加了，呼应上文解决学生不来上课的问题。
questions.supplement:
A(attempt)：a) 语境句：He made no attempt to hide his anger when he heard the news. b) 固定搭配：make an attempt, attempt to do
B(attendance)：a) 语境句：The school rewards students who have a perfect attendance record. b) 固定搭配：school attendance, attendance record
C(chance)：a) 语境句：You will have a chance to ask questions at the end of the lecture. b) 固定搭配：by chance, a good chance
D(stare)：a) 语境句：The boy gave a blank stare when the teacher asked him a question. b) 固定搭配：an icy stare, a blank stare

questions.explanation: 在科学俱乐部里，学生可以亲自“操作(operate)”不同的设备，包括望远镜，呼应后文的hands-on training（实践训练）。
questions.supplement:
A(purchase)：a) 语境句：The company plans to purchase new equipment to increase production. b) 固定搭配：purchase price, make a purchase
B(observe)：a) 语境句：Scientists are using telescopes to observe the movement of the stars. b) 固定搭配：closely observe, observe the rules
C(fetch)：a) 语境句：Could you fetch my glasses from the living room for me? b) 固定搭配：fetch a doctor, fetch a high price
D(operate)：a) 语境句：The staff will teach you how to operate this machine safely. b) 固定搭配：operate a machine, operate successfully

questions.explanation: 有了实践训练，学生们开始“理解/吸收(taking in)”他们曾经觉得复杂的概念和现象。take in在此作“理解”讲。
questions.supplement:
A(taking in)：a) 语境句：It took me a while to take in all the information. b) 固定搭配：take in information, take in the scenery
B(setting aside)：a) 语境句：He has been setting aside some money every month for a new car. b) 固定搭配：set aside money, set aside time
C(working on)：a) 语境句：The engineers are working on a new design for the smartphone. b) 固定搭配：work on a project, work on a problem
D(coming across)：a) 语境句：I came across an old friend while walking in the park. b) 固定搭配：come across a problem, come across as

questions.explanation: Kar的影响力并没有“结束/止步(end)”于课堂。下文提到他在网上分享视频，说明他的影响力延伸到了网络。
questions.supplement:
A(popularize)：a) 语境句：The TV show helped popularize science among teenagers. b) 固定搭配：popularize science, popularize knowledge
B(originate)：a) 语境句：The game is thought to have originated in ancient China. b) 固定搭配：originate in/from, originate with
C(end)：a) 语境句：The meeting didn't end until late in the evening. b) 固定搭配：come to an end, end up doing
D(weaken)：a) 语境句：The long illness severely weakened his immune system. b) 固定搭配：weaken the immune system, weaken the impact

questions.explanation: 人们可以无需任何“订阅(subscription)”就能观看他分享的视频。下文的free materials（免费材料）证实了这一点。
questions.supplement:
A(knowledge)：a) 语境句：Reading books helps broaden your knowledge of the world. b) 固定搭配：basic knowledge, a wealth of knowledge
B(device)：a) 语境句：The smart watch is a useful device for tracking your health. b) 固定搭配：electronic device, mobile device
C(access)：a) 语境句：Only authorized personnel have access to this confidential information. b) 固定搭配：have access to, gain access to
D(subscription)：a) 语境句：You can cancel the magazine subscription at any time. b) 固定搭配：annual subscription, subscription fee

vocab_pack.definition_en: tidy, in good condition; nice
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语，修饰 toys，表示玩具干净完好。
vocab_pack.example_en: She keeps her desk neat and organized.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她保持书桌整洁有序。
vocab_pack.from_passage: over 200 old but neat toys

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put things on top of each other
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词 piled 作后置定语，表被动，即 toys that are piled。
vocab_pack.example_en: The books were piled high on the shelf.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 书高高堆在架子上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: 200 old but neat toys piled in the Jaya Durga high school

vocab_pack.definition_en: be intended for a particular purpose or person
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动结构，一般现在时，主语 these toys，be动词 are，否定形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: This room is meant for meetings only.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个房间只用于开会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: These toys are not meant for the primary graders for entertainment.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a student in elementary school (Grades 1‑6)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作介词 for 的宾语，graders 是 grader 的复数形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Primary graders enjoy learning through games.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 小学生喜欢通过游戏学习。
vocab_pack.from_passage: not meant for the primary graders

vocab_pack.definition_en: to explain or make something clear by examples or pictures
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to illustrate 在句中表目的。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher used a diagram to illustrate the water cycle.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师用图表说明水循环。
vocab_pack.from_passage: employs them to illustrate complex science concepts

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a particular way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作方式状语，修饰动词 illustrate。
vocab_pack.example_en: He explained the problem in a clear manner.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他以清晰的方式解释了这个问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: illustrate complex science concepts in a simple manner

vocab_pack.definition_en: introducing new ideas or methods
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰 teaching approach。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company is known for its innovative products.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家公司以其创新产品闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: For this innovative teaching approach

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a prize or honor to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态（he's awarded = he is awarded），一般现在时，表示现在被授予。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was awarded a scholarship for her excellent grades.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她因成绩优异获得奖学金。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he's awarded the National Teachers' Prize

vocab_pack.definition_en: to recognize the value or importance of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态（was never appreciated），一般过去时，表示过去没有被重视。
vocab_pack.example_en: His hard work was finally appreciated by the manager.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的努力终于得到了经理的赏识。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Science education here was never appreciated till Kar joined

vocab_pack.definition_en: up to the time when; until
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 连词引导时间状语从句 till Kar joined。
vocab_pack.example_en: I will wait here till you come back.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我会在这里等到你回来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was never appreciated till Kar joined the school

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: neither a school lab nor passion
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that two things are not true or do not happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 并列否定结构，连接两个名词短语作 there was 的主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Neither the teacher nor the students knew the answer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师和学生都不知道答案。
vocab_pack.from_passage: there was neither a school lab nor passion among the children

vocab_pack.definition_en: to plan something to happen at a particular time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态（was scheduled），过去时，后接不定式 to begin。
vocab_pack.example_en: The meeting is scheduled for next Monday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 会议安排在下周一。
vocab_pack.from_passage: science class was scheduled to begin after the midday break

vocab_pack.definition_en: a rest period in the middle of the day, usually for lunch
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作介词 after 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students eat lunch during the midday break.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生们在午休时间吃午饭。
vocab_pack.from_passage: after the midday break

vocab_pack.definition_en: to eat a meal
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语 having food 作伴随状语，表示“回家吃饭”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We usually have food together at the canteen.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们通常在食堂一起吃饭。
vocab_pack.from_passage: students would return home having food

vocab_pack.definition_en: to return
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词短语 coming back 作介词 without 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: After the holiday, they came back to school.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 假期结束后他们回到学校。
vocab_pack.from_passage: without coming back

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause or force someone to take a particular action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 drove，搭配 drive + 宾语 + to do。
vocab_pack.example_en: Hunger drove him to steal bread.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 饥饿驱使他偷面包。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This was what drove Kar to use toys.

vocab_pack.definition_en: by choice, willingly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰动词 come。
vocab_pack.example_en: She voluntarily helped the old man cross the street.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她主动帮助老人过马路。
vocab_pack.from_passage: children love toys and would voluntarily come to class

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use something as a toy; to amuse oneself with
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to play with 作定语修饰 one（一个玩具）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cat likes to play with a ball of yarn.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 猫喜欢玩毛线球。
vocab_pack.from_passage: if you give them one to play with

vocab_pack.definition_en: cheap; not expensive
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词作定语修饰 aids。
vocab_pack.example_en: Low-cost airlines make travel more affordable.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 低成本航空公司使旅行更实惠。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Kar started creating low-cost aids by using toys

vocab_pack.definition_en: to involve someone in an activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to engage ... in 表目的，students 是宾语，experiments 是介词 in 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher engaged the class in a lively discussion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师让全班参与热烈的讨论。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to engage students in experiments

vocab_pack.definition_en: attractive, interesting, or pleasing
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 有吸引力的，令人感兴趣的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作宾语补足语，在 make + object + become appealing 结构中。
vocab_pack.example_en: The idea of a beach holiday sounds very appealing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 去海滩度假的想法听起来很吸引人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: making the whole process become appealing to them

vocab_pack.definition_en: the desire to know or learn about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作主语，谓语 grew 是过去式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Children's curiosity drives them to ask many questions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 好奇心驱使孩子们问很多问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As students' curiosity grew

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become larger in number, amount, or degree
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 increased 作谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The population of the city increased rapidly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该城市的人口迅速增长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the attendance at science classes increased

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use or control a machine or equipment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 情态动词 could 后接动词原形 operate。
vocab_pack.example_en: He learned how to operate the new software.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他学会了如何使用这个新软件。
vocab_pack.from_passage: students could operate different pieces of equipment

vocab_pack.definition_en: involving practical experience rather than theory
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词作定语修饰 training。
vocab_pack.example_en: The course offers hands-on experience in the lab.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这门课程提供实验室的动手实践机会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The hands-on training has been their favorite.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to understand and remember something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 taking in 跟在 begin 后，表示开始理解。
vocab_pack.example_en: It took me a while to take in all the information.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我花了一段时间才理解所有信息。
vocab_pack.from_passage: they begin taking in concepts and phenomena

vocab_pack.definition_en: difficult to understand or deal with
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作宾语补足语，在 find + 宾语 + 形容词结构中。found 是过去式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The instructions were too complicated for me.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些说明对我来说太复杂了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: concepts and phenomena they once found complicated

vocab_pack.definition_en: to investigate or search for new ideas or tools
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 exploring 用在现在进行时（is exploring）中。
vocab_pack.example_en: Scientists continue to explore the mysteries of the ocean.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科学家们继续探索海洋的奥秘。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who's exploring more creative tools

vocab_pack.definition_en: to finish or stop
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，does not end，主语 impact 是第三人称单数，但用 does 助动词后接动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The story does not end here; I will tell you more tomorrow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 故事还没有结束，我明天再告诉你更多。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Kar's impact does not end in the classroom.

vocab_pack.definition_en: an agreement to pay for regular access to a service
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作介词 without 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: You can watch the movie without a subscription.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 无需订阅即可观看这部电影。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which people can watch without any subscription

vocab_pack.definition_en: requiring help, support, or basic necessities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作后置定语修饰 kids。
vocab_pack.example_en: The charity provides food for families in need.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 慈善机构为贫困家庭提供食物。
vocab_pack.from_passage: kids in need

questions.explanation: 不定冠词 a 后需接名词，结合语境表达大自然作为一种“提示/提醒物”，应用 remind 的名词形式 reminder。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(reminder)：语境句：The monument serves as a constant reminder of the war. 固定搭配：a reminder of, a gentle reminder。原词remind其它变形：remind (v.), reminding (n./adj.)。常见搭配：remind sb of sth, remind sb to do sth。

questions.explanation: 引导 find 后的宾语从句，且从句中 longing for 缺少宾语，因此填 what，意为“我一直渴望的东西”。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(what)：语境句：You are what you eat. 固定搭配：what to do, what's more。原词无变形。常见搭配：no matter what, what about。

questions.explanation: 时间状语 over the past decade 常与现在完成时连用，主语为 I，因此用 have explored。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(have explored)：语境句：Scientists have explored the ocean floor for decades. 固定搭配：explore the possibility, explore nature。原词explore其它变形：exploration (n.), explorer (n.)。常见搭配：space exploration, an early explorer。

questions.explanation: 与形容词 beautiful 并列，作表语修饰 the Longji Rice Terraces，故用 memory 的形容词形式 memorable，意为“难忘的”。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(memorable)：语境句：Our trip to Paris was a truly memorable experience. 固定搭配：memorable experience, highly memorable。原词memory其它变形：memorize (v.), memorial (n./adj.)。常见搭配：in memory of, commit to memory。

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 be familiar to sb，意为“对某人来说是熟悉的”。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(to)：语境句：The face in the photograph looked vaguely familiar to me. 固定搭配：be familiar to, to some extent。原词无变形。常见搭配：to sum up, to begin with。

questions.explanation: except 后引导两个并列的 that 宾语从句，第一个 that 被省略(except the waves...)，第二个 that 前需用并列连词 and 连接。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(and)：语境句：He is a talented musician, and he also writes his own songs. 固定搭配：and so on, both...and...。原词无变形。常见搭配：wait and see, try and do。

questions.explanation: 此处为非谓语动词作后置定语修饰 terraces。梯田与建设(build)之间是被动关系，故用过去分词 built。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(built)：语境句：Rome wasn't built in a day. 固定搭配：well-built, built-in。原词build其它变形：building (n.), builder (n.)。常见搭配：build up, build on。

questions.explanation: 考查倍数表达法“A is + 倍数 + the size of + B”，特指大小，用定冠词 the。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(the)：语境句：He is the tallest boy in our class. 固定搭配：the same as, by the way。原词无变形。常见搭配：in the morning, at the moment。

questions.explanation: 主语 The construction 与 complete 之间是被动关系，且由 but 连接与 began 并列的谓语动词，指代发生在过去的事，故用一般过去时的被动语态 was completed。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(was completed)：语境句：The construction of the bridge was completed last year. 固定搭配：be completed by, successfully completed。原词complete其它变形：completion (n.), completely (adv.)。常见搭配：upon completion, complete a task。

questions.explanation: 逗号后为非谓语动词作结果（或伴随）状语。主句整体情况导致了这一自然结果，主动关系用现在分词 leaving。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(leaving)：语境句：The storm passed, leaving behind a trail of destruction. 固定搭配：leave for, leave behind。原词leave其它变形：left (过去式/过去分词), leavings (n.)。常见搭配：leave alone, leave out。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to a large degree
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词，修饰过去分词 expressed，表示程度。在句中与cannot be构成被动结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: The topic has been extensively studied.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个话题已被广泛研究。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cannot be extensively expressed in words

vocab_pack.definition_en: to convey through language
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，be expressed in words，be动词省略；过去分词expressed后接介词短语in words表示方式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Some emotions are difficult to express in words.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有些情感难以用语言表达。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cannot be extensively expressed in words

vocab_pack.definition_en: to function as something that causes one to remember
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语it（第三人称单数），serve加s；as a reminder为介词短语作宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: This monument serves as a reminder of the sacrifices made.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座纪念碑提醒人们铭记所做出的牺牲。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It serves as a reminder of the relation between things

vocab_pack.definition_en: the connection that exists between two or more things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词relation后接介词between，表示两者之间的关系。句中为the relation between things and my place。
vocab_pack.example_en: The relation between diet and health is well-known.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 饮食与健康之间的关系是众所周知的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the relation between things and my place in the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: the role or position that someone has in life or society
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，常用所有格限定（如my, one's）；句中作介词of的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Traveling helped him find his place in the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅行帮助他找到了自己在世界上的位置。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my place in the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: to desire something very much
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词形式longing for，在定语从句中与am构成进行时态（am always longing for），表示持续渴望的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She longs for peace and quiet.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她渴望平静与安宁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: what I'm always longing for

vocab_pack.definition_en: a relationship or link to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词connection后接介词to，表示与某事物的联系。句中为the connection to the essence of nature。
vocab_pack.example_en: I feel a strong connection to this place.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我感觉与这个地方有强烈的联系。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the connection to the essence of nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: the basic or most important quality of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词essence后接of，表示“……的本质”。句中the essence of nature作介词to的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The essence of his argument is simple.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他论点的本质很简单。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the essence of nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who writes about their travels
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合名词，单数可数，前面用不定冠词a；在句中作主语同位语。
vocab_pack.example_en: As a travel writer, she visited over 50 countries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 作为一名旅行作家，她访问了50多个国家。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As a travel writer

vocab_pack.definition_en: during the last ten years
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作时间状语，常用于现在完成时（句中has explored）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Technology has changed rapidly over the past decade.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在过去的十年里，科技迅速改变。
vocab_pack.from_passage: over the past decade

vocab_pack.definition_en: worth remembering; unforgettable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，在句中与beautiful并列作表语，且使用最高级most memorable。
vocab_pack.example_en: The trip was a memorable experience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这次旅行是一次难忘的经历。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the most beautiful and memorable

vocab_pack.definition_en: to some extent; a little
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 程度副词，修饰形容词familiar。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am somewhat tired after the long walk.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 走了很长的路后我有点累。
vocab_pack.from_passage: somewhat familiar to me

vocab_pack.definition_en: known to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词familiar后接介词to，表示对某人熟悉。句中familiar to me作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The song is familiar to many people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这首歌为许多人所熟悉。
vocab_pack.from_passage: somewhat familiar to me

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move or run down smoothly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作定语修饰rice fields，表示“向下流淌的”。flow为不及物动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Water flows down the hill after rain.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 雨后水从山上流下。
vocab_pack.from_passage: green rice fields flowing down the mountain

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to emotions; arousing emotion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，与sensory并列修饰experiences。
vocab_pack.example_en: The movie had a powerful emotional impact.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部电影产生了强烈的情感冲击。
vocab_pack.from_passage: emotional and sensory experiences

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to the senses (sight, hearing, etc.)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，与emotional并列修饰experiences。
vocab_pack.example_en: The sensory appeal of fresh bread is strong.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新鲜面包的感官吸引力很强。
vocab_pack.from_passage: sensory experiences

vocab_pack.definition_en: very surprising or impressive
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中使用比较级more amazing，作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The view from the top was amazing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 从山顶看到的景色令人惊叹。
vocab_pack.from_passage: more amazing

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow a twisting path through something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语paths复数，wind为动词原形。wind的过去式为wound。
vocab_pack.example_en: The river winds through the valley.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 河流蜿蜒穿过山谷。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The paths wind through the terraces

vocab_pack.definition_en: to construct so as to become part of a larger structure
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 把……建在……里/使成为……的一部分
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语built into作定语修饰terraces，表示“被建在山坡上的”，带被动含义。
vocab_pack.example_en: Shelves were built into the wall.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 架子被嵌入墙内。
vocab_pack.from_passage: terraces built into the hills

vocab_pack.definition_en: to care for, look after
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，与with连用：with locals tending to their crops。
vocab_pack.example_en: She tends to her garden every morning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她每天早上照料她的花园。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with locals tending to their crops

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reach as far as a particular point
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语a view为单数，故动词stretch加s；to介词表示方向。
vocab_pack.example_en: The desert stretches to the horizon.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 沙漠一直延伸到地平线。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a view that stretches to the horizon

vocab_pack.definition_en: at a height measured from the level of the sea
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作状语或定语，表示海拔高度。句中修饰数字范围：300 to 1,100 meters above sea level。
vocab_pack.example_en: The mountain is 4,000 meters above sea level.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那座山海拔4000米。
vocab_pack.from_passage: above sea level

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cover a specific amount of space
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语they（复数），occupy为原形；an area作宾语，后接of短语表示具体面积。
vocab_pack.example_en: The forest occupies an area of 500 square kilometers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这片森林占地500平方公里。
vocab_pack.from_passage: occupy an area of about 66 square kilometers

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to compare sizes, meaning X times as large as
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 用于比较：数词+ times + the size of + 名词，表示前者是后者的多少倍大。句中作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new stadium is three times the size of the old one.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新体育场是旧体育场的三倍大。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which is roughly five times the size of London Heathrow Airport

vocab_pack.definition_en: approximately; not exactly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词，修饰介词短语five times the size of...，表示近似值。
vocab_pack.example_en: The journey takes roughly two hours.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅程大约需要两个小时。
vocab_pack.from_passage: roughly five times

vocab_pack.definition_en: unique; unlike anything else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词，由连字符连接，作定语修饰combination。
vocab_pack.example_en: This is a one-of-a-kind opportunity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这是一个独一无二的机会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a one-of-a-kind combination

vocab_pack.definition_en: a mixture of different things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词combination后接of，表示“……的组合”。句中of后接三个并列名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dish is a combination of flavors.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这道菜是多种风味的组合。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a one-of-a-kind combination of history, natural wonders, and lively traditions

vocab_pack.definition_en: a remarkable natural feature or phenomenon
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为复数形式natural wonders，与history、lively traditions并列作of的宾语。单数形式为natural wonder。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Grand Canyon is a natural wonder.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大峡谷是一个自然奇观。
vocab_pack.from_passage: natural wonders

vocab_pack.definition_en: a tradition that is active and full of life
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词lively修饰复数名词traditions，句中与history、natural wonders并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: The village maintains its lively traditions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 村庄保持着充满活力的传统。
vocab_pack.from_passage: lively traditions

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide someone with something (a feeling, memory, etc.)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作结果状语；leave sb with sth结构。句中leaving me with lasting memories，leave的现在分词形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The experience left her with a sense of wonder.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那次经历给她留下了一种惊奇的感觉。
vocab_pack.from_passage: leaving me with lasting memories

vocab_pack.definition_en: a memory that remains for a long time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词lasting修饰名词。句中为复数形式lasting memories，作介词with的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The trip created lasting memories.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这次旅行创造了持久的回忆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: lasting memories

vocab_pack.definition_en: interesting experiences to share with others
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式to tell作定语修饰stories；固定搭配，常与have连用。句中作with的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: After his adventures, he had many stories to tell.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 冒险之后，他有很多故事可以讲。
vocab_pack.from_passage: stories to tell
